requirements.title: Borrower card
requirements.description: Residents shall register for a library card using proof of address.

requirements.title: Loan renewal
requirements.description: Borrowers shall extend a book loan before its due date.

requirements.title: Book return
requirements.description: Borrowers shall return borrowed books at a staffed desk or return box.

requirements.title: Overdue charge
requirements.description: Borrowers shall pay a daily charge for overdue books.

requirements.title: Book reservation
requirements.description: Borrowers shall reserve a checked-out book and receive notice when it is ready.

requirements.title: Study room booking
requirements.description: Members shall reserve an available study room time slot.

requirements.title: Reading event signup
requirements.description: Visitors shall register for a reading event with limited seats.

requirements.title: Catalogue search
requirements.description: Visitors shall search the book catalogue by title, author, or subject.

queries.message: Can locals get a borrowing pass with a utility bill?
Let readers keep a novel another week before it is due.
Stop charging people for late books.
If someone books a study room, can they also reserve a checked-out novel?
A returned book should become available to the next person on its wait list.
Search the catalogue by a writer's name.
The book club wants a new coffee machine next month.
Maybe the reading event could have a livestream one day.
queries.label_note: Changes the delivery mode of the existing event, not a separate streaming baseline.

queries.message: Extend my library book and tell me when the one I queued for arrives.
The reading event should let visitors choose seats, and members should still be able to book a study room.

requirements.title: Journey planner
requirements.description: Passengers shall plan a train journey between stations.

requirements.title: Fare quote
requirements.description: Passengers shall view the fare for a selected journey.

requirements.title: Ticket purchase
requirements.description: Passengers shall buy a train ticket by payment card.

requirements.title: Ticket refund
requirements.description: Passengers shall request a refund for an unused ticket.

requirements.title: Station gate validation
requirements.description: A station gate shall validate the barcode on a ticket.

requirements.title: Delay notice
requirements.description: Passengers shall receive a push notification when their train is delayed.

requirements.title: Platform display
requirements.description: Station screens shall show each train's departure platform.

requirements.title: Accessible assistance
requirements.description: Passengers shall book boarding assistance for a wheelchair journey.

requirements.title: Bicycle place
requirements.description: Passengers shall reserve a bicycle space on a train.

requirements.title: Seat reservation
requirements.description: Passengers shall reserve an available numbered seat.

requirements.title: Crew roster
requirements.description: Dispatchers shall assign train crew to scheduled services.

requirements.title: Vehicle maintenance
requirements.description: Depot staff shall log scheduled maintenance of train vehicles.

requirements.title: Service incident
requirements.description: Controllers shall record service disruption incidents.

requirements.title: Lost property
requirements.description: Station staff shall register items found on trains.

requirements.title: Station map
requirements.description: Visitors shall view a map of station entrances and exits.

requirements.title: Season pass
requirements.description: Commuters shall purchase a monthly travel pass.

queries.message: How much would it cost to get from North to South?
Return my money for an untravelled journey.
Tell riders on their phones if the service is late.
Show which track the train departs from, and alert riders when it is running late.
Reserve both a numbered chair and a place for my cycle.
Don't let the gate accept a copied barcode.
A platform worker found a laptop on the train; record it.
We need a platform for publishing train history articles.
Could dispatch assign a replacement conductor to a delayed service and log the disruption?
Next year commuters may buy a monthly pass with a card and plan their trip before travelling.
queries.label_note: Card purchase materially touches the generic payment-card ticket purchase requirement.

requirements.title: Field registry
requirements.description: Growers shall register fields with boundary coordinates.

requirements.title: Crop plan
requirements.description: Growers shall record the crop planted in each field.

requirements.title: Seed stock
requirements.description: Storekeepers shall track quantities of seed by variety.

requirements.title: Soil sample
requirements.description: Technicians shall record soil test results by field.

requirements.title: Irrigation schedule
requirements.description: Growers shall schedule watering for each field.

requirements.title: Pump control
requirements.description: Operators shall start and stop irrigation pumps remotely.

requirements.title: Water meter
requirements.description: Sensors shall record irrigation water volume by field.

requirements.title: Rainfall log
requirements.description: Sensors shall record daily rainfall at each farm.

requirements.title: Air temperature log
requirements.description: Sensors shall record hourly air temperature at each farm.

requirements.title: Frost warning
requirements.description: Growers shall receive an alert before forecast frost.

requirements.title: Pest sighting
requirements.description: Workers shall report pest sightings by field.

requirements.title: Spray plan
requirements.description: Supervisors shall approve pesticide spray plans before application.

requirements.title: Chemical inventory
requirements.description: Storekeepers shall track pesticide container quantities and expiry dates.

requirements.title: Tractor assignment
requirements.description: Managers shall assign tractors to field jobs.

requirements.title: Fuel log
requirements.description: Drivers shall log fuel added to farm vehicles.

requirements.title: Machine service
requirements.description: Mechanics shall record scheduled maintenance of farm machines.

requirements.title: Worker roster
requirements.description: Managers shall assign workers to daily farm shifts.

requirements.title: Work hours
requirements.description: Workers shall submit hours worked per shift.

requirements.title: Safety incident
requirements.description: Supervisors shall record workplace safety incidents.

requirements.title: Harvest record
requirements.description: Workers shall record harvested crop weight by field.

requirements.title: Produce grade
requirements.description: Inspectors shall grade harvested produce by batch.

requirements.title: Batch traceability
requirements.description: Packers shall link produce batches to source fields.

requirements.title: Packing order
requirements.description: Packers shall record cases packed for each customer order.

requirements.title: Cold room temperature
requirements.description: Sensors shall log cold room temperature every fifteen minutes.

requirements.title: Shipment dispatch
requirements.description: Dispatchers shall record produce shipments leaving the farm.

requirements.title: Produce recall
requirements.description: Quality staff shall identify and hold batches affected by a recall.

requirements.title: Produce sale
requirements.description: Sales staff shall invoice customers for produce orders.

requirements.title: Customer payment
requirements.description: Finance staff shall record payments received against invoices.

requirements.title: Yield report
requirements.description: Managers shall export monthly crop yield by field as CSV.

requirements.title: Staff access
requirements.description: Administrators shall assign grower, worker, manager, and finance roles.

requirements.title: Field photographs
requirements.description: Workers shall attach photographs to field inspection notes.

requirements.title: Change audit
requirements.description: The system shall record who edited a farm record and when.

queries.message: Warn us before a freeze ruins the orchard.
Keep track of how much water each paddock consumed.
Record the field's soil acidity after each lab test.
When the pests appear, file a sighting and get approval before spraying.
Stop letting drivers add fuel records after their shift ends.
The monthly CSV should show yield and which parcel supplied each batch.
If produce is recalled, hold the affected lots and tell dispatch not to send them.
Our tractors need new paint to match the website.
Could finance see invoices and register customer remittances?
queries.label_note: Finance access is explicit in the request.

queries.message: Next season the farm might replace its cafeteria menu.
